one_liner: LinkedIn Ads (Marketing API) has a broad REST API using 3-legged OAuth 2.0. Access requires a developer app plus approval for the Advertising API product, in Development and Standard tiers. Only community MCP servers appear to exist, and the fetched pages don't confirm that.
auth_notes: All Marketing API permissions are 3-legged (authorization code). 2-legged/client-credentials auth is explicitly unavailable for marketing use cases.
access_notes: Apply for the Advertising API product from the app's Products tab in the Developer Portal. Advertising API is a vetted product with Development and Standard tiers. Development tier: unlimited reads, edits for up to 5 ad accounts. Standard tier is needed to manage many accounts, and LinkedIn may decline upgrades at its discretion. The pages don't state that the API is free of charge, so the draft's claim was dropped.
blocker_notes: Advertising API access requires LinkedIn approval via the app's Product tab. A Standard tier upgrade, granted at LinkedIn's discretion, is needed for multi-account campaign management beyond 5 edit-enabled ad accounts.

evidence.quote: Two-legged auth is not available for marketing use cases.
Visit your app's Product tab in the [Developer Portal](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps) to apply for the Advertising API product.
This tier enables you to POST for up to 5 Ad Accounts and GET for an unlimited number of accounts.
Vetted Product with development and standard tiers
